versions.content: {DRAFT} Service Name EthIf_MacSecResetRxSc (DRAFT) Syntax Std_ReturnType EthIf_MacSecResetRxSc ( uint8 CtrlIdx, uint64 Sci ) Service ID [hex] 0x86 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, Non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx CtrlIdx Index of the Ethernet controller within the context of the Ethernet Interface Parameters (in) Sci Secure Channel Identifier for the MACsec's Reception Secure channel Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted Description Requests the Ethernet Inferface (MACsec per SW) or the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to reset to default the MACsec values of the Reception Secure Channel for the given Secure Channel Identifier.
